epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce STAGNATION WARNING false positive duration from >3 visits to 0
requirements: R1: Patch existing task resolution logic to correctly update the project deliverable readiness ratio so that stagnation warnings are cleared upon progress

slices.title: Patch readiness ratio update in task resolution
slices.jtbd: When implementing the readiness fix for this epic, I want to patch the existing task resolution logic, so that the deliverable readiness ratio accurately reflects resolved tasks and clears the stagnation warning.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a project experiencing a STAGNATION WARNING despite task resolution
When a task transitions to resolved
Then the system must correctly recalculate and persist the feature readiness ratio
And clear the STAGNATION WARNING if progress is detected
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the occurrences of stalled readiness ratios after task resolution to 0
